description: This file contains unit tests for the TalkModeRuntime component related to speech recognition and playback plan fallback logic in the OpenClaw project. It verifies default configurations for speech requests and the fallback behavior based on API key presence.

classes.name: TalkModeRuntimeSpeechTests
classes.description: A struct encapsulating unit tests for TalkModeRuntime's speech recognition configuration and playback fallback logic.

methods.name: speech request uses dictation defaults
methods.description: Verifies that the speech recognition request is configured with dictation task hint and partial results reporting.

methods.name: playback plan falls back only from elevenlabs
methods.description: Tests fallback logic for playback plans based on presence or absence of API key and voice ID.
